fusions.name: Crossbar Check
fusions.desc: Drives the shaft crosswise through a cone 3 tiles long that deals 14 damage to everything in it and stuns each enemy for 1 second.

fusions.name: Big Game Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a heavy boar-javelin at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Let It Run On
fusions.desc: 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it for 9 seconds. Each kill you make while it is active restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Riled, Then Skewered
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
